notes: Timestral-209M time-series forecaster for LiteRT (mlboydaisuke/Timestral-209M-LiteRT, Hub revision 11f5cc3534dcdd6cfbb6ccb6f462c733e468b0b0, uploaded 2026-10-23): mistralai/Timestral-209M (revision 9874d252, Modified MIT License, Mistral AI) re-implemented with fixed shapes from mistralai/timestral a534bdbd (Apache-2.0) and converted with litert-torch 0.9.4, one graph per size: the patch embedding, the 24 transformer layers and the quantile head in one call, one signature serving_default, five float32 inputs (patches [2,L,64], dec [2,H,768], bias [1,1,S,S], cos / sin [1,1,S,64]) and one float32 output (output_0 [2,H,32,21], the normalized quantiles); 2 rows = the series and its negation, L context and H decoder patches of 32 steps, S = L + H; the host code in the repository (Python, Kotlin) runs the official forecaster's steps around the call. Four sizes (c2048 = L 64, c8192 = L 256; h256 = H 8, h1024 = H 32), each a float16-weight file (the GPU at FP16 precision; the c2048 ones also the Qualcomm NPU) and an -int8 file (the CPU: ai-edge-quantizer 0.9.0 dynamic-range int8 on the fully connected layers of the first 23 of the 24 blocks). The float16-range rewrites (every RMSNorm input pre-scaled by a power of two, the attention logits at 1/16 with the row maximum subtracted, the softmax input clamped at -3e4, the mask value -3e4) leave float32 results unchanged. artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 (API read 2026-10-23 16:07 JST) = the upload list = the bytes the phone ran (the hold's sha256 read-back, MATCH). The check set: 84 fixture windows (72 from UCI Air Quality, Datadog BOOM and UCI ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014, 12 synthetic; horizons 24 to 720 steps); a phone run runs the windows of its file's size. Paths: M/ = timestral/ of the zoo worktree (branch timestral). Records written 2026-10-23 by the run-9 generator (source). This file: timestral-209m-c8192-h1024.tflite (405,041,792 B), the GPU (FP16) file for contexts of up to 8,192 steps and horizons of up to 1,024 steps; kept off the NPU (as c8192-h256).
quantization: float16 weights (ai-edge-quantizer 0.9.0); float32 inputs and output
